Contract Generator.contract:
Contract ProcessSaleService::makeCashPayment(amount: Real): Boolean {
	definition:
		currentStore: Store = CurrentSale.Belongedstore
	precondition:
		CurrentSale.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		CurrentSale.IsComplete = false and
		CurrentSale.IsReadytoPay = true and
		amount>=CurrentSale.Amount
	postcondition:
		let newPayment: CashPayment in
		newPayment.oclIsNew() and
		CashPayment.allInstance()->includes(newPayment) and
		newPayment.AmountTendered = amount and
		newPayment.BelongedSale = CurrentSale and
		CurrentSale.AssoicatedPayment = newPayment and
		currentStore.Sales->includes(CurrentSale) and
		CurrentSale.IsComplete = true and
		CurrentSale.Time = currentDateTime() and
		newPayment.Balance = amount-CurrentSale.Amount and
		result = true
}
